about: Sample data for the Country pitch demo (docs/design/dot-home.md, 'Country pitch demo (testing)'). Every figure is illustrative, not real. Swap the country, numbers and texts here before recording. Offering ids come from data/knowledge/offerings.json; audience needs and offerings come from the knowledge data, not from this file.
